description: This source file contains functions for rewriting and optimizing Torch JIT graphs specifically for Metal backend, including pattern matching and graph transformations for prepacking operations, fusion, and other optimizations.

methods.name: insertPrePackedLinearOp
methods.description: Replaces linear decompositions with prepacked linear operations in the graph.

methods.name: insertPrePackedConv2dOp
methods.description: Replaces conv2d operations with prepacked conv2d operations in the graph.

methods.name: fuseReluWithPackedOps
methods.description: Fuses ReLU operations with prepacked linear and conv2d operations.

methods.name: fuseHardtanhWithPackedOps
methods.description: Fuses Hardtanh operations with prepacked linear and conv2d operations.

methods.name: metalInsertPrePackedOps
methods.description: Inserts prepacked operations into the graph or module.

methods.name: metalFoldPrePackingOps
methods.description: Folds prepacking operations in the module.

methods.name: metalFusePrePackedConvWithClamp
methods.description: Fuses prepacked conv with clamp operations in the module.

methods.name: metalRemoveMutation
methods.description: Removes tensor mutations from the module's graph.

methods.name: metalRunCanonicalOptimizations
methods.description: Runs canonical graph optimizations on the module.

methods.name: metalOptimizeForMobile
methods.description: Clones and optimizes a module for mobile deployment, including folding, freezing, and other transformations.
